Shipped public SpecLedEx.Case is silently shadowed in the host test VM by test_support/specled_ex_case.ex (Code.require_file under ignore_module_conflict) — specled cannot dogfood its own headline ergonomic; case_test.exs verifies the template by grepping its own source. Rename the fixture module (~52 use sites, mechanical), convert case_template_injects_setup to a behavioural scenario, confirm the SpecLedEx.Case realization binding resolves to lib/specled_ex/case.ex via mix spec.next. Report F7/CF5.

---

## Orchestrator scoping (synthesized 2026-07-25 by /orchestrate-epic from verified code analysis)

## specled_-dn4.3 — Rename test_support `SpecLedEx.Case` → `SpecLedEx.FixtureCase`; behavioral `case_template` scenario (F7)

**Advances:** `specled.coverage_capture`

Matched obligations: requirement `specled.coverage_capture.case_template` (`.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:469-477`) and scenario `specled.coverage_capture.scenario.case_template_injects_setup` (:805-813) — whose `given` is literally *"the production `lib/specled_ex/case.ex` source"*, i.e. the source-grep contract this ticket must convert to behavioral. The `realized_by.api_boundary` entry `"SpecLedEx.Case"` sits at :111 and the surface list names `test/specled_ex/case_test.exs` at :95 and `test_support/specled_ex_integration_case.ex` at :102 (the root `test_support/specled_ex_case.ex` is **not** in the surface list today).

**Primary files:**

- `test_support/specled_ex_case.ex:1` — `defmodule SpecLedEx.Case do`, `use ExUnit.CaseTemplate` (:2), `using opts` injecting `use ExUnit.Case, async: Keyword.get(unquote(opts), :async, true)` and `import SpecLedEx.Case` (:5-10), plus a `setup` that allocates a tmp `root` and ~20 public fixture helpers (`write_files/2`, `write_spec/3`, `write_subject_spec/3`, `read_state/2`, `init_git_repo/1`, `git!/2`, `drain_shell_messages/1`, …). Verified: this file shadows `lib/specled_ex/case.ex`, which is a 19-line `ExUnit.CaseTemplate` whose only body is `setup {SpecLedEx.Coverage, :per_test_boundary}`.
- `test/test_helper.exs:33` — `Code.require_file("../test_support/specled_ex_case.ex", __DIR__)`; :29 `Code.put_compiler_option(:ignore_module_conflict, true)` is what makes the shadow silent.
- `test/specled_ex/case_test.exs` — the source-grep test at :16-28 (`source = File.read!("lib/specled_ex/case.ex")` then three `assert source =~ …`), which is the thing to convert. Note :17-22 already documents the shadow as intentional.
- `lib/specled_ex/case.ex` — unchanged, but its realization binding must be re-confirmed.

**Blast radius, enumerated by grep:**

- `use SpecLedEx.Case` appears **56 times across 52 files** under `test/`.
- **2 of those 56 must NOT be renamed**: `test/mix/tasks/spec_cover_test_test.exs:445` and `:512`. Both sit inside `File.write!` heredocs that scaffold child-BEAM fixture projects (`scaffold_partial_hook_fixture/0` at :429-468 and the exclusivity fixture at :470+); they reference the *real shipped* `SpecLedEx.Case` loaded from the parent ebin. Renaming them would break `unhooked_degrade_partial_hook` and `seeded_exclusive_attribution`.
- Net mechanical rename: **54 occurrences across 51 test files.**
- 5 further `use SpecLedEx.Case` occurrences live in `lib/` as documentation/notice strings and must stay: `lib/specled_ex/coverage.ex:12`, `:45`; `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:9`, `:488`; `lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:2737`.
- `test_support/specled_ex_integration_case.ex` defines `SpecLedEx.IntegrationCase` and contains **zero** references to `SpecLedEx.Case` — untouched.
- **Textual-conflict note:** the 51 renamed files are almost entirely disjoint from the coverage/review test files the other 8 tickets touch. `formatter_test.exs`, `boundary_test.exs`, `mfa_lines_test.exs`, `coverage_closure_test.exs`, `html_test.exs`, `coverage_triangulation_test.exs`, `snapshot_test.exs`, `case_test.exs` all use bare `ExUnit.Case`. The only shared files are `test/specled_ex/case_test.exs` (dn4.1 edits its :45 comment) and `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md`. The three `use SpecLedEx.Case` review tests (`review/html_layout_test.exs:13`, `review/findings_delta_test.exs:2`, `review/file_diff_test.exs:10`) are not touched by any other dn4 ticket.

**Allowed touches (globs):**

- `test_support/specled_ex_case.ex` (rename the file too, e.g. `test_support/specled_ex_fixture_case.ex`)
- `test/test_helper.exs`
- `test/**/*_test.exs` (the 51-file mechanical rename)
- `test/specled_ex/case_test.exs`
- `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md`
- `.spec/realization_hashes.json` (only if the `SpecLedEx.Case` binding re-resolves)
- `CHANGELOG.md`

**Out of Scope (files):** all of `lib/**` (including `lib/specled_ex/case.ex` — the point is that it already ships correctly), `test_support/specled_ex_integration_case.ex`, `test_support/append_only_fixtures.ex`, `docs/**`, every `.spec/specs/*` except `coverage_capture.spec.md`, and specifically **`test/mix/tasks/spec_cover_test_test.exs:445` and `:512`**.

**Out of Scope (intent):**

- No behavior change to the fixture helpers themselves — pure module rename plus the one scenario conversion.
- Do not move root `test_support/` into `test/test_support/` (a plausible-looking cleanup that would change `elixirc_paths` semantics and defeat the `Code.require_file` inertness note at `test/test_helper.exs:29-32`).
- Do not remove `Code.put_compiler_option(:ignore_module_conflict, true)` — drift/refactor fixtures still need it (`test/test_helper.exs:26-29`).

**Verification:**

- `mix test` (full suite — a rename across 51 files earns it)
- `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` (the shadow currently masks conflicts; the rename may surface real ones)
- `mix spec.next` — the ticket's own acceptance signal: confirm the `SpecLedEx.Case` api_boundary binding resolves to `lib/specled_ex/case.ex`. The hash key is `api_boundary/SpecLedEx.Case` in `.spec/realization_hashes.json`.
- `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` then `mix spec.check`
- Stub covering `case_template`: `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:913-928`, **`execute: true`**.

**Overlap risk:** Low on lib files (none), high in principle on `test/**` — but verified nearly disjoint from siblings in practice. Real collisions: `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md` (dn4.1/4.4/4.5/4.6/4.8) and `test/specled_ex/case_test.exs` (dn4.1 comment at :45). Because it is 54 mechanical edits, **land it first** — every other ticket rebases over it trivially, whereas rebasing it over others means re-running the rename.
